title: CommunityPostCreatedPayload
description: community.post.created v1 (OpenVibe.Community server/events.js, queued in the transaction of the change). A reply was posted in a forum thread. Never the body. Envelope: subject { type: post, id }, visibility public when the item is public else internal, priority low, actor the person or service:community.

url.description: The public page, or null when the item is not public.
